content:
maria: Quick pre-deploy checklist for tomorrow 10:00 UTC — deploying inference service v2.3 (weights + kv-cache change). Need a fast read of runbook + rollback criteria before I kick off the canary. Who's the deploy owner and who is on-call for rollback?

jon: I can own the deploy. timeline: start 10:00, canary 10:05 (5%), ramp at 10:20. I will be available for the whole window.

taylor: Smoke tests I'll run during canary:
- health endpoint /health (200, all replicas)
- 10 synthetic prompts from smoke set (latency median < 150ms)
- 95th pct latency < 300ms
- embed-check: compare 50 embeddings to baseline (cos sim > 0.9)
- app-level sanity: deploy a single internal route to v2.3 and run E2E checkout flow

siddharth: Rollback criteria (my suggestion):
1) error rate > 0.8% for 5m OR
2) 95th latency exceeds 350ms for 5m OR
3) quality regression: avg BLEU/ROUGE/semantic metric drop > 4% on smoke prompts OR
4) downstream job failures (reranker/qa) start spiking
If any trigger hits we execute escape hatch.

maria: +1 to those. Also important: cache invalidation path and model fallback. Add explicit steps for toggles and KV cache.

jon: Escape paths documented below — I'll keep this pinned in the thread so ops can act fast:

- Immediate rollback (fastest):
  rwdctl service update --name=inference --traffic=stable:0 --traffic=v2.2:100
  (this switches traffic back to tagged v2.2 replica pool)

- Toggle-only fallback (no full rollback):
  curl -X POST https://feature-toggle.internal/api/set -d '{"key":"inference.v2_enabled","value":false}'
  then route 100% to v2.2 via router.

- KV cache flush (if corruption suspected):
  redis-cli -h redis-prod -a $REDIS_PASS FLUSHKEYS inference:kv:*
  (this is slower; do during low qps or after rollback)

- Model variant fallback (graceful): update routing table to use small-lm-1 for edge regions:
  rwdctl routing set --service=inference --region=us-west --model=small-lm-1 --pct=100

maria: Good. Can we add an automated smoke-run job to validate post-rollback that the system actually returned to green?

taylor: Yes, i'll add a quick smoke webhook that runs after any traffic switch. Command we use in runbook:

  # post-traffic-check (runs 3x)
  ./scripts/smoke_run.sh --prompts smoke_prompts.json --timeout 30s --report /tmp/smoke.json

deploy-bot: Deploy window check: scheduled deploy window 2026-11-08 10:00 UTC approved by release-manager. Remind: maintenance page will publish at start time. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: I'm oncall for the window. If you need immediate rollback ping @ops-oncall or call pager (pager 1). Will escalate to infra if KV flush required.

jon: Minor note — DB migration included is idempotent (adds telemetry columns) but we should be prepared to block if migrations cause schema lock > 30s. Rollback path for migration: apply shadow migration reversal and route traffic back. I'll watch migration step.

maria: OK — final checklist I will follow before starting:
- confirm owners: jon (deploy), taylor (smoke), ops-oncall (pager)
- run preflight smoke locally + CI check (smoke pass)
- verify toggles and have rollback commands open in terminal
- post-rollback smoke automation ready

If nobody objects, I will start at 10:00 UTC. Otherwise post here by EOD. :clock10:
